from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
__metaclass__ = type

from units.compat import unittest
from units.compat.mock import patch, MagicMock
from ansible.module_utils.net_tools.nios import api
from ansible.modules.net_tools.nios import nios_fixed_address


class TestNiosFixedAddress(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_ipv4_lookup_create_and_idempotence(self):
        params = dict(provider={}, state='present', name='host', ipaddr='192.0.2.10',
                      mac='00:11:22:33:44:55', network='192.0.2.0/24',
                      network_view='default', options=None, extattrs=None, comment=None)
        module = MagicMock()
        module.params = params
        module.check_mode = False
        with patch.object(nios_fixed_address, 'AnsibleModule', return_value=module), \\
                patch.object(api, 'get_connector'):
            with patch.object(nios_fixed_address, 'WapiModule', wraps=api.WapiModule) as wapi_class:
                wapi = wapi_class.return_value
                wapi.get_object.return_value = None
                nios_fixed_address.main()
                expected_filter = dict(ipv4addr='192.0.2.10', mac=params['mac'],
                                       network=params['network'], network_view='default')
                wapi.get_object.assert_called_with(api.NIOS_IPV4_FIXED_ADDRESS,
                                                    expected_filter, return_fields=unittest.mock.ANY)
                wapi.create_object.assert_called_once()

    def test_address_types(self):
        for address, expected, key in [('192.0.2.10', 'fixedaddress', 'ipv4addr'),
                                       ('2001:db8::10', 'ipv6fixedaddress', 'ipv6addr')]:
            module = MagicMock()
            module.params = {'ipaddr': address}
            spec = {'ipaddr': {'ib_req': True}}
            obj_type, spec, module = nios_fixed_address.validate_ip_addr_type(address, spec, module)
            self.assertEqual(obj_type, expected)
            self.assertIn(key, spec)
            self.assertEqual(module.params[key], address)
            self.assertNotIn('ipaddr', spec)

    def test_invalid_address(self):
        module = MagicMock()
        nios_fixed_address.validate_ip_addr_type('bad address', {}, module)
        module.fail_json.assert_called_once()

    def test_options(self):
        module = MagicMock()
        module.params = {'options': [dict(name='router', num=None, value='192.0.2.1',
                                          use_option=True, vendor_class='DHCP')]}
        self.assertEqual(nios_fixed_address.options(module),
                         [dict(name='router', value='192.0.2.1',
                               use_option=True, vendor_class='DHCP')])
EOF
